Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast gap — please verify close dates and stage for Q2 at-risk opps

Team — quick nudge before Monday planning. Finance flagged a ~$420k gap vs plan in our Q2 committed coverage that maps to a small set of medium-to-large deals (list attached). I pulled a short extract and also included the current MAP for RWI-3421.

Action requested by EOD Wed (17th):
- Please confirm the current Salesforce Stage and Close Date for each opp in the attached CSV.
- If there is no active buyer commitment, change Stage -> "Qualification" or "Disqualified" and add a short note.
- If you still have a firm PO/commitment, update Close Date to the expected ship date and reply here with PO timing.

Rationale: The finance team needs a clean committed view for our Q2 forecast call. We should avoid inflating committed dollars with stale close dates — if we need to push coverage into Q3 that's ok but call it out so we can model cash and resource capacity.

Attachments: forecast-coverage-20270314.csv (CSV, 36 KB), RWI-3421-MAP.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

Thanks — Naomi

I'm going to update SF for the above and then run a quick report to capture any other ops with stale close dates > 60 days.
